firmware.title: Amiga
firmware.author: drewpo28; Musashi 68k core
firmware.description: An Amiga 500, 600, 1200 and CD32: OCS, ECS, AGA and Paula sound. Runs ADF, DMS, HDF and CD32 images. Needs 8 MB PSRAM.
firmware.controls: Keyboard, mouse, gamepads. F12: menu, Ctrl+F12: DF0 disk, F11: reset, Win+F11: reboot.
